subject: SIG initiation: MedicaSys security questionnaire & SOC 2/HIPAA clarifications
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medicasys.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medicasys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG initiation: post-call recap + asks

Hi Emily / Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security side:

- Decision point: You said MedicaSys prefers a standard SIG/CAIQ process; can you confirm whether you want the full SIG (scoped questionnaire) or a shorter CAIQ prefill?
- SOC 2: please confirm the most recent SOC 2 type/report date and whether you have a redacted PDF available for sharing.
- HIPAA: you mentioned regulated PHI flows in one pilot — is a BAA required to proceed? If yes, do you have a preferred BAA template or should we send ours?
- Evidence: For a SIG prefill we typically ask for (1) SOC 2 report, (2) architecture diagram (network/dataflow), (3) any three evidence artifacts for technical controls (config screenshots, encryption policy excerpt, access review log).
- Timeline: if you want us to prefill the SIG, we can send the prefill template and drop-in answers within 3-5 business days after we receive SOC2 + architecture diagram.

I attached a blank prefill template (MedicaSys-SIG-prefill-template.xlsx) to make it easy. Proposed next step: Emily, can you confirm which path (full SIG vs CAIQ prefill) and share the SOC2 PDF + any BAA needs by EOD next Wednesday (2027-07-07)?

Short call ok if you prefer. Thanks —

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedicaSys-SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medicasys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medicasys.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: post-call recap + asks

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers below: 

- SIG vs CAIQ: We want a full SIG but would appreciate a prefill from you to speed review. So please send prefill guidance and feel free to populate obvious answers.
- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-11-30). I attached an initial risk assessment for context. I can provide a redacted SOC 2 report (PDF) via secure link once I confirm with our security team.
- HIPAA / BAA: Yes, we need a signed BAA for any production PHI flows. We reviewed Redwood's standard BAA and it's generally OK; however our legal prefers to review our vendor version first. Can you send Redwood's BAA draft so we can kick off legal review?
- Data residency: Our pilots must store data in the US only. Please confirm Redwood's US-only hosting options and whether the SIG prefill should state US-only residency for production.

Requested timeline: we'll aim to share SOC 2 redacted PDF and architecture diagram by 2027-07-07; legal will try to review and flag any BAA concerns within two weeks.

Thanks —
Emily
Emily Zhang | Head of Security & Privacy, MedicaSys
emily.zhang@medicasys.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Attachment: Initial-Risk-Assessment.pdf (document stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation: post-call recap + asks

Emily — perfect, appreciate the confirmations. Next steps from our side: 

1) We'll produce a SIG prefill (answers + control mapping) and a short evidence checklist. That will include recommended artifacts keyed to the SIG control IDs.
2) Please share the SOC 2 redacted PDF and the architecture diagram when available (we'll treat both as confidential).
3) I'll attach our standard BAA for your legal to review (see attachment). If they have redlines, loop in our legal team and we can expedite.
4) US residency: Redwood supports US-only tenancy for private/dedicated deployments — I will note US-only as the target for production in the prefill.

Proposed timeline: we can deliver the prefill + evidence checklist within 3 business days after we receive SOC2 + architecture diagram. If that works, I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up for the week of 2027-07-12 to walk through the prefill.

Quoted from Emily's note:
> We want a full SIG but would appreciate a prefill from you to speed review.
> We have a SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-11-30).
> Yes, we need a signed BAA for any production PHI flows.

Attaching: redwood-sig-prefill-instructions.pdf (short guidance) and Redwood-Standard-BAA.docx (BAA stub).

Thanks —
Ben
